ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 85% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigmentation is localized as a continuous band along the trailing edges and concentrated at the median notch base. Multiple vertical dark-pigment streaks are mapped across the right lobe. A large yellowish-brown chromatic region is localized on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by jagged pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized within the dark-pigmented regions of the outer fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) are present on the right lobe; shorter, similar marks are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark-pigment mottling at the central junction of the lobes; multiple vertical linear scars visible on the distal right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pigmentation patch on the left ventral lobe surface.
